cases.title: Normal trip from the app: start, readings, ML on, finish; no unjustified alarms (4 seeds, default scale)
cases.input: GUI: simulation NORMAL, AI on, seeds 42/777/2026/4100
cases.notes: Driving scale/warm start are not exposed in the UI, so the high-scale cold-start weakness (QA-AI-011) cannot be reproduced through the GUI.

cases.title: Thermal rise through the app: detection, saved event, report with checks
cases.input: GUI: S01 at 60 s, AI on
cases.expected: MS_THERMAL event COMPLETE; report lists cooling check; AI state stated; hedged

cases.title: Air/fuel disturbance through the app: pattern detected, MAF/MAP evidence, readable report
cases.input: GUI: S02 at 60 s, AI on
cases.expected: MS_AIR_FUEL event; technical report shows MAF and MAP residuals; simple report hedged

cases.title: ML + XAI with the real model through the app: an event whose AI result is anomalous shows computed XAI factors; otherwise the state is stated
cases.input: GUI: S05 (voltage) at 60 s, default model v3
cases.expected: AI state in the report; if anomalous, factors line + 'not mechanical causes'; technical report lists XAI method and model version
cases.actual: xai_in_simple=True; model_in_technical=True; ai_label=AI: نشط — نمط معتاد | 0.502 | iforest-cr006-v3

cases.title: Intermittent fault: it appears and disappears but recording continues to T+30 and the event is saved
cases.expected: MS_COMBUSTION COMPLETE with samples from T-30 to T+30

cases.title: Restart: events and reports are restored identically and sessions are not mixed
cases.input: close the app, reopen on the same database, open the same report
cases.expected: same number of events, identical report text, one session

cases.title: Language/theme change, restart, old report rendered in English; stored data unchanged
cases.input: EN + dark -> close -> reopen -> open an Arabic-era report
cases.expected: settings persisted; English report text; database logical hash unchanged

cases.title: RANDOM_FAULTS through the app: 30 s cycles recorded as separate ground truth and compared with detections
cases.expected: cycle schedule stored in simulation_runs; every injected instance listed with detected yes/no
cases.notes: Ground truth lives only in simulation_runs and this QA comparison; the detectors never read it.
